name: campos-munos-redesign
description: Monorepo: site/ (public website, camulaw.com), admin/ (staff portal, admin.camulaw.com), server/ (API, api.camulaw.com). Each deploys on its own from its directory (see docs/architecture-split.md). These ROOT scripts build the transitional single service that the current Railway deployment runs: one process serving the API, the site and the portal under /admin. Railpack's default `npm install` fires postinstall, which installs all three apps.

scripts.postinstall: cd site && npm ci && cd ../admin && npm ci && cd ../server && npm ci --omit=dev
scripts.build: cd site && VITE_API_BASE_URL= npm run build && cd ../admin && VITE_API_BASE_URL= ADMIN_BASE=/admin/ npm run build
scripts.test: npm run build && cd server && npm test && cd ../site && npm test && cd ../admin && npm test
